prompt:
Redraw a finished in-game panoramic illustration for the Maison des cartes in the Breton Quartier, extra-wide 3:1 landscape banner, edge-to-edge. Image 1 is the edit target, interior and master art direction. Keep its intimate cozy wooden counter, the same round-faced smiling Loïc with his teal-and-tan cap and teal overalls, his scale, Breton arched seaside window and blue hydrangeas. Bold slightly irregular black ink contours, simple warm cream paper, teal cabinetry, apricot and ochre wood, sparse screenprinted halftone. The remodel is about the merchandise: absolutely all the generic star, sailboat and isolated head graphics disappear. Make this a distinctively BUDDIES collectible card shop.
Image 2 is the official sealed Buddies collector's booster. Paint its design in the inked style of the shop: tall sealed crimped foil wrapper, blue-silver top seam, gold sunset over green hills, the little teal-and-tan-capped farmer crouching in the lower half among unmistakable palmate serrated cannabis leaves and flowering buds. Copy this same wrapper on the shelves, in the wooden trays and especially on the single fairly large pack Loïc holds upright beside his face with the front facing us. Limit shelf inventory to a few clear groups, natural overlap and side views. Do not turn the booster into a plain green packet with a single leaf. The hero pack and his delighted face should be the first read at small size, both within the middle half. Show off the pack with his hand behind/below it, not covering its face. On a single small cream shop placard attached to the wooden display tray under the displayed booster set the exact letters "BUDDIES" in bold hand-inked teal caps. Make this word readable; no other lettering, number, tagline, price or logo.
On the counter display two individual cream-bordered collectible character cards, arranged to the side of the showcased booster: the smiling cannabis-tree Buddy cradling a globe (image 3) and the round green flowering bud Buddy with brown walking cap, white gloves and a map (image 4). Use distinct simplified portraits from the references. Give the framed wall art a botanical cannabis print. Cannabis identity should be unmistakable through the actual packaging and these characters. Keep the shop picturesque rather than cluttered. Preserve the original village comic's warm daylight and matte printed look even on the foil, with just a couple of decisive light strokes on the crimped seams. NO photo collage, photorealism, UI, outer border, drop shadow, white margins or floating typography. Deliberately compose as a short wide horizontal panorama; all essential details including brand sign and hero pack comfortably within the central 75% of height.
processing: Redimensionnement proportionnel de 2172 × 724 à 1536 × 512. Export WebP, qualité 88.
